_comment: Per-tier separation model config. Each 'model' is an audio-separator model filename (see `audio-separator --list_models`). Override any value at deploy time with the matching env var (MODEL_2STEM / MODEL_4STEM / MODEL_6STEM) without rebuilding. Defaults are robust + MIT-clean; upgrade 4/6-stem to SCNet-XL / BS-ROFO-SW via MSST for higher quality (see README).
